purpose: One zero-model owner-only native header-cut probe: create exactly one bare lifecycle Session with the Goal preset/cwd/meta, run flush/cold observe/live assert with the create-only seq-excluding-header cut, report matched/headerDiff, then always cancel/dispose/archive the Session. No Goal/Task/Effect/budget, no model/embedding, no business writes, zero retry. This is diagnosis only: no fix and no fourth bounded attempt.

expected.receipt: status passed/failed with zero flags, createdSessionId, cold/live facts, matched or headerDiff; cleanup released/disposed/archived
expected.conditionCheck: paused/busy/capacity rejection is reported without creating a Session
expected.audit: exactly one probe Session added and archived; goals/tasks/effects/budget/state unchanged apart from normal lifecycle and the probe Session
